# Rejected paid and inappropriate routes

| Route | Disposition | Reason |
|---|---|---|
| FINOS corporate membership | REJECTED-AS-PAID | New-project route uses a willing existing Member sponsor; no membership purchase. |
| LF/LFDT commercial membership tiers | REJECTED-AS-PAID | Labs proposal is a technical community route; paying does not establish fit or acceptance. |
| Paid audit/certification as a publicity prerequisite | REJECTED-AS-PAID | No prerequisite audit purchase authorized or necessary for this bounded release candidate. |
| Paid awards, listings, standards-vendor programs and sponsored conference visibility | REJECTED-AS-PAID | Recognition must arise from verifiable work and community decisions. |
| FINOS DataHelix upstream target | REJECTED-AS-NOT-APPLICABLE | Repository archived at the live inspection; prefer active upstream projects. |
| SLSA level claim | REJECTED-AS-NOT-APPLICABLE | A provenance record alone does not establish a level; no comprehensive level assessment completed. |
| “Certified” / official Ethiopian conformance listings | REJECTED-AS-NOT-APPLICABLE | Tool has no scheme authority and makes no certification claim. |
